The browser upload test uses a 3000-pixel JPEG derived from NASA’s Apollo 11 photograph AS11-40-5875. Credit NASA. The test exercises camera-sized input, fine surface detail, JPEG encoding, and preview downloads. The fixture is excluded from the production site and offline cache.

[Original NASA photograph](https://images-assets.nasa.gov/image/as11-40-5875/as11-40-5875~orig.jpg)
